jewish.name: Jewish (Yiddish-language proxy)

At the user's direction, Yiddish speakers are assumed to be Jewish; at tract level Yiddish is only available inside the "German or other West Germanic languages" category (residents aged 5+). This is a proxy for Yiddish-speaking households only and misses most Jewish New Yorkers, who do not speak Yiddish at home.
